$comment: Template only. Do not paste an unreviewed title list. A new-game row may start without an NSUID only when it carries retained, dated Nintendo-rank or Steam-heat evidence; discovery then assigns the stable candidateId from verified regional identity. If candidateId is supplied, it must stay bound to NSUID evidence. An optional nintendoUsSlugHint must be an exact retained official-sitemap product slug and is rechecked against the current sitemap. For an existing catalog game, set catalogAction to add_platform_mapping and use that game slug.
